deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the tick-FSM route contract reaches a breaking major version (e.g. the v2 parallelism tier introduces scope/conflict slots that change the edge shape).
title: route.json
description: The tick-FSM transition-table shape: a state set, a (state, signal) -> next_state edge table, and a terminal-state marker. Routing is data, not code, and lives outside every state. This feature owns the shape; the resolver that executes it is tick-orchestrator.

states.description: The set of state symbols. No state names another state.

terminal.description: States at which the machine halts; each must be in `states`.
